RESULT [labelnoise]: Found that 18% of pedestrian labels in the original KITTI ground truth were missing or inaccurate. The best pipeline (YOLOX+MetaDetect) recovered 186-260 of 330 verified false negatives, yet the best methods still miss up to 44% of missing labels (66% under looser settings). Microtask verification cost about 38-125 s per box.
US [labelnoise]: This is the shape the labeller agent should take: a detector flags suspect boxes, and a human in Roboflow or the dashboard confirms each flag in a single click. The 44-66% miss rate shows that automatic cleaning of harvested data cannot be the only gate. Budget human microtasks for the flagged tail, and never auto-overwrite.

US [selftrain]: Harvested public weed datasets will carry label errors of this size or larger. Automatic checks alone miss most errors, so the human budget should go to verifying flagged items, not re-drawing boxes. This bears on the 'high-precision base dataset' step.
